text:
alice: Heads up — heatmap shows mTLS handshake errors spiking in eu-west after yesterday's RBAC change. Seeing lots of client_hello drops on edge proxies. Anyone triaging?
raj: On it. Proxy logs show 'certificate verify failed' and 'no certificate available' for some instances. Rotator logs claim issuance succeeded. Grabbing KMS & audit logs.
sam: Seeing repeated KMS DecryptDenied events at 2024-06-22T02:13:45Z for principal `svc/rotator@eu-west`. RBAC change removed kms:Decrypt for that service role in eu-west. :grimacing:
alice: That fits — rotator might have created a cert record but couldn't unwrap the CA key, so proxies got a stub/expired chain. Could be cert-cache + authz gap.
irene: Pulling the IAM diff now. If that's true we should either re-grant the binding immediately or rollback the change. Which is faster?
raj: Re-grant is fastest. I see terraform plan removed a binding for `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` from the rotator principal in eu-west.
alice: Oncall — patch IAM and then restart rotator in eu-west to force a re-unwrap/push. Command to restart rotator process: `sudo systemctl restart rotator-eu` (or `kubectl rollout restart` in k8s).
irene: Applying IAM patch: re-adding kms:Decrypt for `serviceAccount:rotator-eu@redwood.iam`. ETA ~3m.
rotator-bot: Rotator restart queued for rotator-eu.
irene: IAM change applied. KMS audit now shows Allow for `rotator-eu`.
sam: Restarting rotator now: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/rotator --region=eu-west`
rotator-bot: Restart triggered: rotator-eu (pod/rotator-4123) -> graceful restart started.
raj: After restart, proxy logs show handshakes succeeding for ~60% of traffic. Some proxies still using cached/stale certs. We should rollout edge proxies in eu-west to clear caches: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy -n ingress --region=eu-west`.
alice: Good. Can someone run that? Also we need a quick alert rule: KMS DecryptDenied spike -> page security-oncall.
sam: Rolling edge proxies now. Handshake failure rate dropped from 7.2% -> 0.3% in the last 10m. Looks resolved for eu-west.
raj: Root cause: a terraform change removed IAM binding for rotator principal in eu-west, preventing KMS unwrap during certificate rotation. Rotator emitted issuance events but couldn't complete chain push. Proxies served incomplete certs until rotator restarted and caches cleared.
alice: Action items: 1) Postmortem ticket, 2) add CI/PR guard to flag/remove-of-KMS-perms for principals tagged 'rotator' (block or require approval), 3) add alert for KMS DecryptDenied and rotator 'chain_pushed' missing for >60s, 4) reduce cert cache TTL during rotations. I'll file the tickets.
irene: Also propose audit decorrelation: link terraform plan change id to KMS audit log entries automatically in console for faster triage.
sam: Noted for postmortem: some edge proxies held stale certs for ~2 hours due to long cache TTL; recommend default TTL = 5m for certs during rollout window.
alice: Filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-9123 — title: "RBAC removal caused KMS unwrap deny -> mTLS handshake failures (eu-west)". cc @security-oncall
raj: :thumbsup:
